en: a school supported by a synagogue, church, etc. and attended in addition to an ordinary school
ex: She has religious school on Sunday mornings.
她在周日早晨上宗教学校。

zh: 十分认真地；审慎地；很有规律地
en: very carefully or regularly
ex: She followed the instructions religiously.
她非常认真地按照说明操作。

en: the quality of believing strongly in a particular religion and obeying its laws and practices
to stop having something, especially when this happens unwillingly
ex: He was forced to relinquish control of the company.
他被迫放弃对公司的控制权。

zh: 圣髑盒；盛放圣人遗物的容器
en: a container in which a relic of a holy person is kept

zh: 享受；从…获得乐趣；渴望；喜欢
en: to get great pleasure from something; to want very much to do or have something
ex: to relish a challenge
享受挑战

zh: （尤指在想象中）再次体验，重温；回味
en: to experience something again, especially in your imagination
ex: He relives the horror of the crash every night in his dreams.
每天晚上他都会梦见那次撞车的可怕情景。

en: a relative
ex: All the rellies will be at the party.
所有亲戚都会来参加聚会。

zh: 给…再装填（子弹或胶卷等）
给（计算机）重新装入（数据或程序）
再装满（容器、车辆、机器等）
en: to put more bullets into a gun, more film into a camera, etc.
to move or to move somebody/something to a new place to work or operate
ex: The firm may be forced to relocate from New York to Stanford.
公司也许会被迫从纽约迁移到斯坦福。

en: the act of moving, or of moving somebody/something, to a new place to work or operate
ex: relocation costs
搬迁费用

en: the feeling of being unwilling to do something and hesitating before you do it, because you do not want to do it or because you are not sure that it is the right thing to do
ex: There is still some reluctance on the part of employers to become involved in this project.
雇主们仍然不太愿意参与这项工程。

en: hesitating before doing something because you do not want to do it or because you are not sure that it is the right thing to do
ex: He finally gave a reluctant smile.
他最后露出了一丝无可奈何的微笑。

en: in a way that involves hesitating before doing something because you do not want to do it or because you are not sure that it is the right thing to do
ex: We reluctantly agreed to go with her.
我们勉强答应跟她一起去。

en: to need or depend on somebody/something
ex: The charity relies solely on donations from the public.
该慈善机构完全依靠公众捐款。

en: to need or depend on somebody/something
ex: The charity relies solely on donations from the public.
该慈善机构完全依靠公众捐款。

zh: 快速眼动（夜间做梦时眼睛快速而细微的移动）
en: rapid eye movement (describes a period of sleep during which you dream and your eyes make many small movements)
ex: REM sleep is an essential part of brain function.
REM睡眠是大脑功能的重要组成部分。

en: to continue to be something; to be still in the same state or condition
ex: to remain silent
保持沉默

zh: 其他人员；剩余物；剩余时间
廉价出售的图书；滞销图书
en: the people, things or time that remain
ex: I kept some of his books and gave away the remainder.
我保留了一些他的书，其他的都送人了。
